scientific_integrity: Exact all-dimensional proof uses the classical Cauchy determinant, Sylvester inertia and compact spectral theory. Finite standard-library checks are supplemental, not a substitute for the proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires a genuinely admissible symmetric copula with C1 strictly monotone generator and denominator uniformly positive; excludes singular-denominator endpoints and does not give eigenvalue magnitudes or mixing rates. Priority searches are not exhaustive.
title: Infinite signed spectra in symmetric ratio-type copula chains
